title: Bootstrap common report persistence on existing ERP databases
description: Stage 1 generic persistence runtime gap verified in code: EF EnsureCreated only creates an empty database; SchemaUpgrader currently has no ReportConfiguration bootstrap while existing ErpDbContext.Reporting already maps the three entities. User autonomous authorization permits this exact development bootstrap increment. Use existing Domain/Application contracts; no new model, business report, migration rollout or production execution. Depends on ERP-280 startup repair to prevent overlapping schema edits. Preserve existing data and concurrency semantics.
acceptance_criteria: For an existing ERP database with legacy tables but absent common report tables, add idempotent startup bootstrap for db_owner.ReportConfigurations, ReportConfigurationRevisions and ReportConfigurationGrants. Match existing Domain properties and ErpDbContext.Reporting mappings exactly, including rowversion, defaults, keys, relationships and paging indexes. Preserve all existing tables and business data; rerunning startup must leave definitions, revisions and grants intact. Do not recreate databases, suppress errors or change existing Domain semantics.

On a dedicated exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database, reproduce existing-database bootstrap with only these report tables absent, then verify save/read, publication, pinned recipient sharing/revocation and stale-version rejection using the existing application services. Assert target identity before every destructive fixture setup; never use production fallback. Verify SQL column/index metadata and repeated bootstrap data preservation with offline mapping tests and filtered real SQL tests.

Run scheduler self-test/contracts, focused unit/SQL tests and safe Release build/test. Record exact commands, isolated target and genuine results; do not claim first-stage or browser acceptance. No production connection, deployment, migration execution outside isolated localdb, .env/appsettings changes, new report-specific endpoints, new datasets or Agent work.

human_gate.reason: User-authorized development repair, isolated test database only.
